key_insight: ScoutRoute uses a single cheap scout-model forward pass to infer which expert LLM is most competent, enabling efficient post-hoc routing without retraining the models.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical MoE routing strategy for deploying heterogeneous LLMs with lower inference cost and greater flexibility than joint gating or multi-model evaluation.
method: Extract hidden-state signals from one scout LLM pass.
Train lightweight logistic probes to estimate cross-model competence.
Combine probe scores with logit-based confidence in a domain-aware routing rule.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on five open-weight models across four benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, commonsense reasoning, and multidisciplinary knowledge, and it consistently outperformed individual routing signals.
watch_item: Routing quality depends on the scout model and probe calibration, so domain shift or poor scout selection could reduce expert-selection accuracy.
paper_title: ScoutRoute: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Routing Using Internal Language Model Signals
